subject: Election of Council Officers and Casino Fund Oversight
overview: The Council elected John Falco as President and Richard Caraviello as Vice President for the 2020 term. Major actions included amending a Home Rule petition regarding casino mitigation funds to retain council oversight of expenditures and rejecting a proposal to shift regular meeting nights from Tuesdays to Wednesdays.

items.title: Election of Council Officers
items.summary: John Falco was elected Council President and Richard Caraviello was elected Vice President for the 2020 session.

items.title: Appointment of City Messenger
items.summary: Lawrence Lepore was appointed and sworn in as the City Messenger.

items.title: Adoption of Standing Rules and Transfer of Papers
items.summary: Approved the adoption of standing rules and the transfer of all pending matters from the 2019 Council to the 2020 Council.

items.title: City Beautification and Improvements Advisory Commission
items.summary: Referred a request to the City Solicitor to provide a framework for a draft ordinance establishing an advisory commission for city beautification.

items.title: Eversource Pipeline Project Updates
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting representatives from the Eversource Pipeline Project appear quarterly to provide updates and address public safety and environmental concerns.

items.title: Traffic Signal Timing and Safety Updates
items.summary: Approved a request for the City Traffic Engineer to address signal timing on Harvard Street and requested safety updates for the South and Main Street intersection.

items.title: Home Rule Petition for Casino Mitigation Funds
items.summary: Amended a Home Rule petition for a special revenue fund for casino mitigation payments to require City Council appropriation for all expenditures; the petition was approved as amended.

items.title: Brewery Ordinance Progress
items.summary: Approved moving forward with the brewery ordinance and requested legal updates from the City Solicitor and the Liquor Commission regarding alcohol service regulations.

items.title: Ceremonial Recognitions
items.summary: Approved resolutions honoring the memory of Michael J. Callahan, congratulating Max Stevens on a Deaf Olympics gold medal, and recognizing Sumbul Siddiqui as the first Muslim mayor in Cambridge.

items.title: Lime Bike Removal
items.summary: Approved a request to remove a lime bike from the corner of Harvard Avenue and Mystic River Road.

items.title: Proposal to Change Meeting Night
items.summary: Rejected a proposal to move regular City Council meetings from Tuesday to Wednesday nights because of concerns regarding public notification, parking, and childcare planning.

items.title: OPEB Trust Fund Ordinance
items.summary: Adopted an ordinance establishing the Other Post-Employment Benefits (OPEB) Trust Fund to comply with state Department of Revenue regulations.

items.title: Commendation of Retiring City Solicitor
items.summary: Commended retiring City Solicitor Mark Rumley for 36 years of service and legal guidance to the municipality.

items.title: 551 Winthrop Street Development Oversight
items.summary: Requested a report and appearance by the Building Commissioner and Community Development Director to address resident concerns regarding blasting and the project scope at 551 Winthrop Street.
